title: 第7章 天机阁传人之言叶擎空是真命天子第8章 一纸退婚叶家求见
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
待得看清楚上面的内容之后，萧战天脸色霎时间变得无比铁青，拳头更是捏的死死的，强行逼迫自己忍住当场动手的想法。
他万万没想到对方竟然是准备的如此充分！
简直是厚颜无耻！
而这还不算完，叶擎空仿佛没有看见他脸上的愤怒之意般，挺胸抬头，年仅十五六岁的稚嫩脸上流露出目空一切的自傲之色。
言语间毫不掩饰高高在上之意。
“萧老前辈，以萧家的情报网络，想必也是瞒不住您的。”
“您恐怕早就知道，我已经拜师九玄门宗主了吧，而以九玄门的实力，在整个青罗域内想必也不用我再做过多介绍了吧。”
萧战天脸色铁青，额头之上青筋暴涨，被一个年仅只有十五六岁的少年如此羞辱，就连普通成年人都难以忍受。
更何况他还是偌大萧族的族长！
“我与洛珺仙之间是没有可能的，从我拜入九玄门那一刻起，她与我就注定是两个世界的人。”
“萧老前辈明知道这是无可争议的事实，为何还非要强行攀上这根高枝呢。”
“当年祖父在我年幼之时所定下的婚约并未经过我本人同意，所以还请萧老前辈收回成命！”
随着叶擎空铿锵有力的声音落下，整个萧家议事大厅内顿时陷入死一般的寂静，一众萧家人的脸色简直比吃了苍蝇还要难受。
唯独叶家族老的脸上流露出满意之色，得意的抚着雪白胡须。
当年名动青罗域的天机阁传人来到天香国之时恰巧经过王都，自感与此地有缘便在叶家待了半日。
随即算出，叶家在不久的将来会出现一名真正旷古绝今的天骄人物！
当时叶家之人听闻此言之时无不是被震惊的五体投地，他们万万没有想到名动四方的天机阁传人竟然会给出如此之高的评价。
甚至一些年长之人依稀记得当时那神秘高深莫测的天机传人，脸上所带着的难以置信和惊讶。
可碍于天机阁的威信，众人也只好半信半疑，以为是当初的天机阁传人故意给他们叶家面子，往大夸了去的。
可如今随着叶擎空的横空出世，此时叶家内部也已经逐渐相信了这则预言。

虽说目前的叶擎空还没有成长到那种震动寰宇的地步。
但叶家对他有着充足的信任，特别是在其受到九玄门赏识，拜师观主之后，这种信任更是达到了前所未有的巅峰！
故此才会毅然决然的，即便摒弃掉与萧家百年来交好的情谊，也要不留情面的收回这桩婚姻成命。
因为叶家众人相信，叶擎空的未来道路是星辰大海，不应该迎娶一名普通女子为妻，这只会成为他前进道路上的阻碍！
那些大势力天骄圣女将会是更好的选择，唯独她们才有资格陪伴在叶擎空左右。
这便是来自于十五岁锻体圆满巅峰的底气！
比之世俗天才的十八岁锻体巅峰尚且还要早上足足三年的时间！
十年的时间，再加上大势力九玄门的倾力培养，绝对足够让叶擎空在二十五岁之前打通七十二条地脉的一半以上！
这便是来自于叶家的底气！
正因为有着如此底气在，他们才可以丝毫不在意这个往昔情同手足的兄弟势力的想法。
content_en:
After he could clearly read the content above, Xiao Zhantian's face turned extremely pale in an instant, and his fists were clenched tightly, forcing himself to resist the idea of ​​taking action on the spot.
He never expected that the other party was so well prepared!
How shameless!
And this wasn't over yet, as if Ye Qingkong didn't see the anger on his face, he straightened his chest and raised his head, with a look of arrogance and arrogance on his immature face of only fifteen or sixteen years old.
There was no concealment of condescension in his words.
"Senior Xiao, with the Xiao family's intelligence network, I guess I can't hide this from you."
"I'm afraid you already know that I have already become the master of the Jiu Xuan Sect, and with the strength of the Jiu Xuan Sect, there is no need for me to make too many introductions to the entire Qingluo Territory."
Xiao Zhantian's face was livid, and the veins on his forehead were bulging. Being so humiliated by a boy who was only fifteen or sixteen years old was unbearable even for ordinary adults.
What's more, he is also the leader of the huge Xiao clan!
"There is no possibility between me and Luo Junxian. From the moment I worshiped the Jiuxuan Sect, she and I were destined to be people from two different worlds."
"Senior Xiao knows that this is an indisputable fact, so why does he insist on forcing himself to climb this high branch?"
"The marriage contract my grandfather made when I was young was not approved by me, so I ask Senior Xiao to take it back!"
As Ye Qingkong's sonorous and powerful voice fell, the entire Xiao family meeting hall suddenly fell into deathly silence. The faces of the Xiao family members were as uncomfortable as eating flies.
Only the elder of the Ye family showed satisfaction on his face, stroking his snow-white beard proudly.
When the descendant of Tianji Pavilion, who was famous in Qingluo Territory, came to Tianxiang Kingdom, he happened to pass by the royal capital. Feeling that he was destined to this place, he stayed at Ye's house for half a day.
He then calculated that in the near future, a truly outstanding figure would appear in the Ye family!
At that time, everyone in the Ye family was shocked when they heard this. They never expected that the famous heir of Tianji Pavilion would give such a high evaluation.
Even some older people vaguely remember the disbelief and surprise on the face of the mysterious and unpredictable Tianji successor at that time.
However, due to the prestige of Tianji Pavilion, everyone had to be dubious, thinking that the original successor of Tianji Pavilion deliberately exaggerated to give them the Ye family face.
But now with the emergence of Ye Qingkong, the Ye family has gradually come to believe this prophecy.
Although the current Ye Qingkong has not grown to the point where he can shock the world.
But the Ye family has sufficient trust in him, especially after he was appreciated by Jiuxuanmen and became a disciple of Guanzhu, this trust has reached an unprecedented peak!
That's why he was resolute, even if he gave up the good friendship with the Xiao family for hundreds of years, he still had to take back the marriage without mercy.
Because everyone in the Ye family believes that Ye Qingkong's future path is to the stars and the sea, and he should not marry an ordinary woman as his wife. This will only become an obstacle on his way forward!
Those powerful and talented saints will be better choices, and only they are qualified to accompany Ye Qingkong.
This is the confidence that comes from reaching the peak of physical training at the age of fifteen!
Compared to the worldly genius who reached the peak of physical training at the age of eighteen, it was still three years earlier!
Ten years, coupled with the efforts of the powerful Jiuxuanmen to cultivate him, will definitely be enough for Ye Qingkong to open up more than half of the seventy-two earth veins before he is twenty-five!
This is the confidence from the Ye family!
Precisely because they had such confidence, they could not care at all what this brotherly force thought of them in the past.
